name: Lecouz Core for Easy Building Company
author: hweb

sections.description:
Lecouz Core for Easy Building Company adds what a theme should not contain, so your content survives a theme switch:

  • Services and Projects content types
  • 27 custom widgets for the free Elementor (heroes, services, projects, pricing, FAQ, key figures, quote form, shop widgets and more)
  • One-click demo importer with four demos (Painter, Plumber, App, Shop) and clean removal
  • Quote / contact form with e-mail notification (sent to the e-mail set in the theme Customizer, or the site admin e-mail)
  • Cookie consent banner with editable texts and an on/off switch (it can be switched off if you use another consent plugin)

It is designed for the Easy Building Company theme, and needs the free Elementor plugin for the widgets. The Shop demo needs WooCommerce.

The plugin does not contact any external server and does not collect any data.

See the live demos: https://lecouz.ch

Author: Haris Ukalo – https://lecouz.ch

Copyright

Lecouz Core for Easy Building Company, Copyright 2026 Haris Ukalo. Distributed under the GNU GPL v2 or later.

Resources:

  • Demo illustrations (demo//images) and demo preview images: created by the author, GPL v2 or later.
  • No third-party libraries are bundled.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Install the free Elementor plugin if you want the widgets.
  3. Open Easy Building Company > Demo Import in the admin menu, pick a demo and click Import.
  4. Cookie banner settings: Easy Building Company > Cookie consent.
sections.faq:
Which images do the demos use?

The demos use simple illustrations drawn for this plugin (GPL). Replace them with your own photos.

Can I turn the cookie banner off?

Yes, in Easy Building Company > Cookie consent.

1.5.0

  • First release in the WordPress plugin directory.
